purpose: Final DynaMol v0.1.1 software release audit: source UI, file/API formats and measurements; representative protein/ligand/ion/cofactor and supported loop preparation; fresh 10 ps explicit-water OpenMM and GROMACS checkpoint/stop/resume runs; read-only historical output revalidation. Numerical and functional checks only, no biological accuracy, tautomer populations, metal coordination, convergence or experimental prediction claims.

reproducibility.hardware: Local Apple Silicon CPU; native AmberTools and OpenMM Reference/CPU; no cloud or GPU compute
reproducibility.budget: 44 representative chemistry template/ligand cases with minimal numerical continuity, three real complex preparations and solvations (6DBK, 6A93, 1UA2), bounded native timeouts; two 10 ps explicit-water runs with checkpoint interruption/stop/resume, max four CPU threads combined. Prior five-system trajectories read-only. Optional UI preparation and small demonstration run.

inputs.matrix: 43 existing cases plus Zn; representative PTMs, missing ligand atom repair and 1UA2 supported loop; explicit unsupported chemistry boundaries. Native matrix and actual complex work recorded separately.

data.policy: Preserve identities, elements, all deposited heavy atoms and stereochemistry; no parent-residue mutation, arbitrary GAFF on covalent proteins, fabricated parameters or silent removal. Keep view/identity/preparation/native-check status separate. Explicitly disclose fixed protonation assumptions and nonbonded ion limitations. Resume must preserve topology/system/config/platform compatibility and retained coordinates. RMSD/RMSF use documented selections, alignment/reference, units and handling of periodic boundaries. Missing ligand atom repair is explicit and preserves observed atoms with geometry checks; supported internal loop builds up to 12 residues per gap are provisional models, never asserted to reproduce experimental coordinates.

validation.scope: Tests against native Amber/OpenMM and analytic/synthetic motion baselines; exact charges/connectivity/stereochemistry checks, failure-case regressions; checkpoint compatibility and output continuity; finite simulation diagnostics. Representative tests cannot establish universal chemical coverage.

comparison.notes: Software checks, no scientific ranking, held-out experimental benchmark or convergence claim.

review_identity: Language-model evidence synthesis and automated PatAgent checklist; not a domain-expert certification or Pat Walters endorsement.
